card.title: The Ritual Explains Itself Later
card.instruction: Treat one unexplained recurring action as essential. Allow its meaning to change each time it returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your audition, knock twice on this door. We can't skip that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They knocked back. Can we go in? My hands are shaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twice again. Now we're saying we're ready, even if your hands aren't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're calling me in alone. How will I know you're still here?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll knock twice when your song ends. This time it means I'm staying until you come out.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 required knocks lack an initial explanation, A3 makes them readiness and A5 makes them a promise of remaining nearby.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants to enter despite nerves and B4 asks how to know support remains outside.

heightening.evidence: B4 separation gives A5 the same action a concrete new meaning tied to the end of the audition song.

specificity.evidence: A1 audition door and B2 nerves establish an immediate performance and supporting relationship.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 staying until you come out makes the repeated knock a practical assurance, not arbitrary ritual.
